yelp_review_snippets: [5★ - kimy durants]: "I recently visited St. David's Medical Center and had a positive experience overall. From the moment I arrived, the staff were professional and treated me with kindness and respect. The check-in process was straightforward, and I didn't feel lost or overwhelmed. The facility was clean and well maintained, which helped make the visit more comfortable. The doctors and nurses took the time to answer my questions and explain things clearly. I appreciated that they didn't seem rushed and made an effort to keep me informed. Hospitals are never places people particularly want to spend time in, but the care I received made the experience easier. Overall, I felt well looked after and would feel comfortable returning here if I needed medical care in the future."

[5★ - Thomas Ng]: "My wife was admitted to ER due to aneurysm rupture in December and stayed at the hopspital for 3 weeks. The treatment and care was top-notched - After 12 more days in inpatient rehab she was back to being independent. No outpatient rehab was needed! I know this is quite an exceptional case and I thank God for that but a lot of credits go to the skilful doctors their medical teams for staying on top of things! I also stayed with my wife through those 3 weeks because I am retired and I know decisions could come quickly. Based on my observation and experience, everyone put my wife's welfare as their high priority - treatment, testing, recovery, comfort, etc. Everyone working in the hospital seemed to be wearing a smile, which is very important for the patient, her caregivers and visitors. Special thanks to the wonderful nurses who did above and beyond in taking care of my wife including Becca, Bobbi, Jiliane, Jordana, Madie, Meg, Max... The hosptial is conveniently located by I-35 and within very short distance from a lot of amenties. The facility was very well maintained and clean, expecially the ICU on the 5th floor. I was very happy that I was able to stay with my wife comfortably on the sitting couch or lounge chair. Wifi was very stable, enabling me to stay connected with families and friends. No one likes hospital foods but the food here has certainly changed my impression. They tried very hard to impress - Lots of choices, beautiful plating, Keeping texture of the food, etc. And they were serious in sticking with the patient's diet restriction. The only down side was the portion seemed to be a little overly generous, causing food waste. Finally, I have to point out that our visitors and I all love the free parking for seniors! Please keep that policy going! Thank you, St David's Medical Center!"

[5★ - Norma Beliveau]: "Went in for a SVT ablation. Not really knowing what to expect I put myself in the hands of my doctors and the hospital. When I woke up after the procedure I felt as if nothing happened and felt great. I had no complications and had a great experience in the hospital. The doctors and staff were remarkable. Everyone were great and knew their jobs well. Everyone was kind and caring. Thank you all I love St David's."

My wife was admitted to ER due to aneurysm rupture in December and stayed at the hopspital for 3 weeks. The treatment and care was top-notched - After 12 more days in inpatient rehab she was back to being independent. No outpatient rehab was needed! I know this is quite an exceptional case and I thank God for that but a lot of credits go to the skilful doctors their medical teams for staying on top of things! I also stayed with my wife through those 3 weeks because I am retired and I know decisions could come quickly. Based on my observation and experience, everyone put my wife's welfare as their high priority - treatment, testing, recovery, comfort, etc. Everyone working in the hospital seemed to be wearing a smile, which is very important for the patient, her caregivers and visitors. Special thanks to the wonderful nurses who did above and beyond in taking care of my wife including Becca, Bobbi, Jiliane, Jordana, Madie, Meg, Max... The hosptial is conveniently located by I-35 and within very short distance from a lot of amenties. The facility was very well maintained and clean, expecially the ICU on the 5th floor. I was very happy that I was able to stay with my wife comfortably on the sitting couch or lounge chair. Wifi was very stable, enabling me to stay connected with families and friends. No one likes hospital foods but the food here has certainly changed my impression. They tried very hard to impress - Lots of choices, beautiful plating, Keeping texture of the food, etc. And they were serious in sticking with the patient's diet restriction. The only down side was the portion seemed to be a little overly generous, causing food waste. Finally, I have to point out that our visitors and I all love the free parking for seniors! Please keep that policy going! Thank you, St David's Medical Center!

Went in for a SVT ablation. Not really knowing what to expect I put myself in the hands of my doctors and the hospital. When I woke up after the procedure I felt as if nothing happened and felt great. I had no complications and had a great experience in the hospital. The doctors and staff were remarkable. Everyone were great and knew their jobs well. Everyone was kind and caring. Thank you all I love St David's.
